about: Story problems (R-37): short stories in the student's interest that turn into a two-step equation, solved line by line. Slots {team}, {player}, {unit}, {units}, {container}, {containers} come from the skin (R-38, made-up teams only); {a}, {b} and {c} from the generator, with x the thing the story asks for ('unknown'). 'form' is the equation the story claims. 'hints' are about the story and never give the equation (R-02); each slip is a wrong setup offered beside the right one, with the story question the tutor asks when it's picked. Read by web/src/mock/stories.ts; the catalog's descriptors are story-<id>.

stories.text: The {team} have {b} points so far this season. They win {a} points a game. How many more games until they have {c} points?
hints: What changes each game, and what stays the same?
Where do the {b} points come from: before these games, or during them?

slips.hint: The {team} start with {b} points. Do those get added to the total, or taken off it?
What changes each game, and by how much?

stories.text: {player} has {b} {units}. Each day brings {a} more. In how many days will {player} have {c} {units}?
hints: What does {player} start with, and what changes each day?
Which number happens once, and which happens every day?

slips.hint: The {b} {units} were there at the start. Are they added to the total, or taken away?
What changes each day, and by how much?

stories.text: The {team} put {a} {units} in each {container}. There are {b} left over, and {c} {units} in all. How many {containers} did they fill?
hints: Which number is in every {container}, and which is counted only once?
If there were one more {container}, how many more {units} would there be?

slips.hint: The {units} left over are still counted. Do they add to the total, or come off it?
What goes in every {container}, and what is counted once?

stories.text: {player} gets {a} {units} a week for the {team}. So far {player} has given {b} away and has {c} left. How many weeks has it been?
hints: What comes in every week, and what went out once?
Did giving {b} {units} away make the total go up or down?

slips.hint: The {b} {units} were given away. Does that make the total go up or down?
What comes in every week, and how many at a time?

stories.text: The {team} get {a} points a game. A penalty took {b} points off, and they finished on {c}. How many games did they play?
hints: Which number happens once, and which happens every game?
Did the penalty make the total go up or down?

slips.hint: A penalty takes points away. Does that add to the total, or take from it?
What happens every game, and what happened once?
